name: Archive of PEACEMINUSONE
rootCause: According to news, the NFT series "Archive of PEACEMINUSONE" released by Korean singer Quan Zhilong has the previously disclosed CVE-2022-38217 general vulnerability, and the possibility of being used by hackers cannot be ruled out.
